channel.title: The Smithfield Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Smithfield Times (smithfieldtimes.com)

item.title: Top Marketing and Communication Courses for Career Growth in 2026
item.description: In 2026, Effective communication is crucial in the workplace, with 86% of employees and executives saying lack of communication is a top cause of failures, and teams with strong communication see up to 25% higher productivity.

item.title: Top 7 AI Leadership Programs to Drive Business Strategy in 2026
item.description: By 2026, the global artificial intelligence market is projected to surpass $300 billion, shifting from experimental pilots to full-scale enterprise integration.

item.title: More snow, sub-freezing temperatures expected this weekend
item.description: One week after Winter Storm Fern, another named storm – Gianna – is forecasted to bring sub-freezing temps and multiple rounds of snow to Isle of Wight and Surry counties.

item.title: Former IW County Administrator ‘Sonny’ Owen remembered for stability, sense of humor
item.description: Former Isle of Wight County administrator W.B. “Sonny” Owen, credited with bringing stability and key water and tax agreements in the 1980s, has died at 95.

item.title: Court blocks redistricting constitutional amendment that divided local lawmakers
item.description: A Virginia judge has halted an April referendum on a mid-decade redistricting constitutional amendment, ruling lawmakers broke their own rules. Democratic leaders have appealed.

item.title: Surry County approves architect, construction manager for YMCA facility
item.description: Surry County picked an architect and builder for a YMCA, aiming to start construction this fall and open the facility by fall 2027.

item.title: Editorial – Essential workers rise to occasion during storm
item.description: After Winter Storm Fern knocked out power and coated roads, linemen, road crews, trash collectors and other essential workers kept Isle of Wight and Surry moving — and proved preparation pays.

item.title: Weapon scanners to debut at Smithfield, Georgie Tyler middle schools in February
item.description: Isle of Wight County middle schools are planning an early February rollout of new weapon scanners, expanding security measures first launched at Smithfield and Windsor high schools.

item.title: Rare triple threat: Nor’easter to bring blizzard, flooding and freezing to Smithfield
item.description: Winter Storm Gianna could bring blizzard conditions, moderate tidal flooding, days of subfreezing temps and 6-8 inches of snow to Isle of Wight and Surry counties. Smithfield has seen similar winter nor'easters before, but rarely.

item.title: IW Education Foundation awards over $36K in teacher grants
item.description: The Isle of Wight Education Foundation awarded 37 Isle of Wight teacher grants totaling $36,760 to fund innovative classroom projects across eight schools, funded by its annual gala.
